why: Referrals V2 (0x6B7E93536bB94F33617A71d3aDC5dE35Ea14ee7B) claimRebates(address) is the only permissionless call in Bounce.Tech that moves money out. In the last 7 days (blocks 50,858,909-51,502,437) 5 ClaimRebate events paid 5 distinct EOAs 267.14 USDC total: 0x4a4a098a9d3f899cfceec14d1b6a04e61035c32d652ab40403f5ed5e5056e03f 199.93 to 0x1279697ff2648bb1437d07bd3fc21e0d989f5334; 0x394ac5eb0c56b72245773af110b645f4041ddbac4a66794b7e15941a8cb355c2 29.88 to 0x75d2ba3da5a598ea48d499bc172fb6b4713229a3; 0x1338e7283b4e3d805a9dd456650050dbfb109ac9a03d9549e0c77ee1c4abbc6a 21.53 to 0x8e100ca591bba6ce8b1d174f14312d3dbc066c3c; 0x71802249b3baec5ae80a1c53d849a8eeb0c2a307dcbaf75c9d3e3695709b278b 15.62 to 0x7aec64f09ec5ae443727f15f9f1dadfc75f6c56a; 0x77afd008c9b4be7d23e935113be486ca0ed57935a48681b1b9703e67d2f11bfe 0.19 to 0x58e03d622a88b4012ee0a97235c6b110077fb867. Every one of them was a self-claim (caller == user), which is the catch: claimRebates(user) sends the USDC to user_, not to msg.sender, so a keeper calling for a stranger pays gas and gets 0. Pot is not empty right now: getRebate(0xcc029db0386cd36cae20d4b7373d4bc669588f54) = 14.85, getRebate(0x991635d76bd22414cffc3eaad63b8b8d3b14ae88) = 11.25 USDC.
next_steps: Contract Referrals V2 0x6B7E93536bB94F33617A71d3aDC5dE35Ea14ee7B on hyperevm, function claimRebates(address user_), 7-day count 5 (sample of all 5). Gross per call 0.19-199.93 USDC (5 sample calls above), median ~21.53; gas 72,534 per claim (eth_getTransactionReceipt) = 0.0005 USD at 0.1005 gwei (eth_gasPrice 2026-11-17) x HYPE 68.96 USD (coins.llama.fi), 0.0185 USD even at the worst effective gas price seen (3.694 gwei). Gross > gas by ~3-5 orders of magnitude, but the payment is to the recipient argument, not the caller: only an address with its own accrued rebate can capture it, and accrual requires minting/redeeming LT (redemption fees of ~0.1-0.2% of notional, of which referrerRebate/refereeRebate bps come back). Nobody races it: 5 claims in 7 days, users claim by hand, so first-block competition is nil. For the farm this is only worth something if the farm itself holds LT and rebates accrue on its fees; there is no keeper revenue here, because all the real keeper functions (checkpoint, bridgeToCore, bridgeToEvm = onlyAgents; executeRedemptions = onlyExecutors registry) pay the caller nothing and the redemption/streaming fees go to the Referrals pot, treasury 0x7fe37fc2f987eb981a0fc63cf1eabf04463550d4 and the feeHandler. Referral codes are self-service (generateCode(string) is permissionless in V2), so an affiliate angle exists off-chain but nothing on-chain pays a caller for other people's volume.
